capabilities: Extend any toast's display time to a configurable minimum duration
Persist all toasts on screen until clicked
Log recent toasts from any plugin or core for later review
Configure minimum duration, persist mode, and log size in settings
extras: Patches the undocumented internal API Notice.prototype.setAutoHide, so it may need updates if Obsidian changes how Notice schedules auto-hide; only affects toasts created after the plugin loads. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: patches the single method Obsidian's Notice class uses internally to schedule its auto-hide timer
motivation: The author cites long-standing user complaints that notification toasts disappear too fast or are broken, with no built-in way to control their duration.
problem: Obsidian toasts auto-hide after a fixed 4 seconds with no setting to change it, so messages with useful detail vanish before they can be read.
summary: Toast duration controller that patches Obsidian's Notice class so notifications last longer, stay until dismissed, and are kept in a reviewable log.
